priorities.heading: Cost of Living & Small Business
priorities.quote: I'll push for a pro-growth, pro-work agenda: cut wasteful spending that feeds inflation, reduce red tape on small manufacturers, and protect the skilled-trades economy that powers Southwest Washington.

priorities.heading: Education: Parental Rights & College Affordability
priorities.quote: I support the Parents Bill of Rights at the federal level.

priorities.heading: Crime, Homelessness & Public Order
priorities.quote: I'll pair compassion with consequences: shut down open-air drug markets, support local camping bans when shelter is available, supercharge fentanyl interdiction, and fund detox and mental-health beds.

housing.quote: I'll pair compassion with consequences: shut down open-air drug markets, support local camping bans when shelter is available, supercharge fentanyl interdiction, and fund detox and mental-health beds.
housing.note: From his section on crime and homelessness (camping bans when shelter is available).

immigration.heading: Secure the Border, Stop Fentanyl
immigration.quote: I'll complete high-priority barriers, hire and equip more agents, deploy proven technology, tighten asylum loopholes, and go after cartel supply chains.

foreign-policy.heading: Veterans & National Defense
foreign-policy.quote: I'll support a lethal, modern force, care for veterans with faster access to care and benefits and rebuild the industrial base—especially small manufacturers—so America never fights short of parts or people.

climate-energy.heading: Energy Independence
climate-energy.quote: I'll champion market-based production including hydropower, solar, oil, natural gas and nuclear power.

priorities.heading: Fighting for Reproductive Freedom
priorities.quote: Marie will do whatever it takes to prevent a national abortion ban, which would override the will of the people of Washington State.

priorities.heading: Safeguarding Our Communities & Securing the Border
priorities.quote: Marie will always fight to make sure state and local law enforcement agencies have the resources they need to keep Fentanyl and illegal guns off of our streets.

priorities.heading: Championing the Right to Repair
priorities.quote: She is working to stop manufacturers of farm and consumer equipment from gouging their customers by forcing them to pay the original manufacturer for repairs.

cost-of-living.heading: Fighting Inflation
cost-of-living.quote: Marie has been working in Congress to combat unfair business practices — like opposing mergers of major grocery chains and opposing deceptive “Shrinkflation” food packaging.

housing.heading: Supporting Working Families
housing.quote: In Congress, she is working to bring down the cost of housing, increase choices for childcare options, and cut out the middlemen who jack up the cost of healthcare.

health-care.heading: Supporting Working Families
health-care.quote: In Congress, she is working to bring down the cost of housing, increase choices for childcare options, and cut out the middlemen who jack up the cost of healthcare.
health-care.note: Her one sentence on health costs, from her section on working families.

immigration.heading: Addressing Substance Abuse
immigration.quote: Marie believes in fighting the drug crisis through increased border security, stricter punishments for sale and possession, expanded access to treatment and rehab, and better job opportunities.
immigration.note: Her only line on the border, from her section on drug abuse. Her "Securing the Border" section is about police funding.

climate-energy.heading: Acting on the Climate Crisis
climate-energy.quote: Marie has also championed tax-rebates for energy efficiency upgrades for working class families, like weather skirting for mobile homes.
